title: Chizkiyah, Hillel’s Brother
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: So it is cited in Shalshelet HaKabbalah that he was the patriarch in Babylonia, but Hyman says he has found no source for this. In Seder Olam Zuta another Exilarch named Chizkiyah is mentioned, but he lived long after the destruction.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Seder Olam Zutta narrative names a Chizkiyah succeeding Shechanyah after its account of the destruction. It does not identify him as Hillel’s brother. The Shalshelet HaKabbalah passage has not been directly collated; Hyman’s statement that he found no source remains his expressed skepticism, not a new claim that no source exists.
